title: Smart routes: a system for development and comparison of algorithms for solving vehicle routing problems with realistic constraints
abstract: arXiv:2608.14140v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The problem of route optimization with realistic constraints is becoming extremely relevant in the face of global urban population growth. While we are aware of approaches that theoretically provide an exact optimal solution, their application becomes challenging as the problem size increases because of exponential complexity. We investigate the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (CVRPTW) and compare solutions obtaining by exact solver SCIP with heuristic algorithms such as LKH, 2-OPT, 3-OPT, the ORTools framework, and the deep learning model JAMPR. We demonstrate that for problem of size 50 deep learning and classical heuristic solutions became close to SCIP exact solution but requires less time. Additionally for problems with size 100, SCIP exact methods around 13 times slower that neural and classical heuristics with the same route cost and on around 50% worse for the first feasible solution on the same time. translated_title: 智能路线：一个用于开发和比较解决具有现实约束的车辆路径问题算法的系统
translated_abstract: 随着全球城市人口的增长，具有现实约束的路线优化问题变得极为重要。虽然我们知道理论上能提供精确最优解的方法，但随着问题规模增大，由于指数级复杂度，其应用变得困难。我们研究了带时间窗的容量约束车辆路径问题（CVRPTW），并比较了精确求解器SCIP与启发式算法（如LKH、2-OPT、3-OPT、ORTools框架）以及深度学习模型JAMPR所得的解。我们证明，对于规模为50的问题，深度学习和经典启发式解接近SCIP的精确解，但所需时间更少。此外，对于规模为100的问题，SCIP精确方法比神经和经典启发式方法慢约13倍，但路径成本相同，而在相同时间内首次可行解的质量差约50%。
tldr: 该论文提出一个比较系统，证明在解决带时间窗的容量约束车辆路径问题时，深度学习与经典启发式算法在接近精确解的同时显著提升效率，尤其在大规模问题上优势明显。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a comparison system showing that deep learning and classical heuristics achieve near-exact solutions for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows while significantly reducing computation time, especially for larger instances.
